list.title: Notes
list.rowHint: Touch and hold to pin or delete

empty.title: No notes yet
empty.description: Jot down what's on your mind or record a conversation. Jarvi transcribes it, sums it up and suggests next steps.

deleteDialog.title: Delete note?
deleteDialog.description: This note's notes, summary and transcript will be deleted. This can't be undone.

notFound.title: Note not found
notFound.description: It may have been deleted on another device.

detail.saveFailed: We couldn't save. We'll try again on your next edit.
detail.webFormatting: This note has formatting from the web app. Edit it on your computer to keep the formatting.

denied.title: Microphone blocked
denied.message: Allow microphone access in Settings to record your notes.

leave.title: Stop recording?
leave.message: What you've recorded so far will still be transcribed.

record.interrupted: Recording stopped because of an error. What was recorded is still being transcribed.

empty.title: No transcript yet
empty.recording: The transcript shows up here every 30 seconds while you record.
empty.idle: Start recording to see the transcript here.

summary.needsSource: Write a few notes or record some audio first.

regenerateDialog.title: Regenerate?
regenerateDialog.message: The current summary, including your edits, will be replaced.

empty.title: No summary yet
empty.description: Jarvi writes a summary from your notes and the transcript.

summary.outdated: Your notes or transcript have new details since this summary.

tasksSync.skipped_one: One step changed and didn't become a task. Open the note again and retry.
tasksSync.skipped_other: {{count}} steps changed and didn't become tasks. Open the note again and retry.
tasksSync.title: Sync with tasks
tasksSync.checking: Checking whether any step is already in your tasks…
tasksSync.description: The selected next steps go to Tasks.
tasksSync.descriptionMatches: Checked steps go to Tasks. If one is already there, the note uses the task you have instead of repeating it.
tasksSync.prepareFailed: We couldn't get the steps ready. Close and try again.
tasksSync.willUse: Will use the task you already have
tasksSync.willUseAs: Will use the task you already have: “{{title}}”
tasksSync.linked_one: Step tied to the task you already had
tasksSync.linked_other: {{count}} steps tied to tasks you already had

stepReview.title: Already a task?
stepReview.message: “{{text}}” looks like a step you already turned into a task: “{{existing}}”. If it's the same one, it stays linked to that task. If it's different, you can create a separate task for it.

chat.emptyDescription: Jarvi reads the notes, the transcript and the summary, and can create tasks from them.
